connector.name: Mushi Mushi
connector.registryDescription: Bug translation for vibe coders: plain-English diagnosis + paste-ready fix in your AI coding agent
connector.summary: Hosted at dxptnwrhwsqckaftyymj.supabase.co over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kensaurus account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <MUSHI_API_KEY> — a project API key with the mcp:read (and optionally mcp:write) scope.

env.name: MUSHI_API_KEY
env.description: Project ingest/admin API key minted in the Mushi console (Settings → API Keys). Scope mcp:read for triage, mcp:write to dispatch fixes.

env.name: MUSHI_PROJECT_ID
env.description: Project UUID the key belongs to. Optional for single-project account keys.

env.name: MUSHI_API_ENDPOINT
env.description: Override the API base URL (self-hosted deployments). Defaults to the hosted Mushi Cloud endpoint.

env.name: MUSHI_FEATURES
env.description: Comma-separated feature groups to expose (triage,fixes,inventory,setup,docs). Defaults to the lean catalog; use 'all' for the full tool set.
